name: code-reviewer-container
description: Ephemeral container for AI code review pre-compute: git clone, AST parsing, and static analysis binaries.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --outfile=dist/server.js --format=esm --packages=external && mkdir -p dist && date +%s%N > dist/cachebust.txt
